answer: Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The anchor graph is validated at intake and the whisper frontier is published, which means the ancestry of every answer is public, and cipher anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Verification costs 24 dollars and 3 days per identity, which turns a 1706 account sybil into a 8 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
